brand.name: Fieldnote Studio
brand.tagline: Gardens planned around how you actually use them
brand.summary: A two-person garden design practice. We survey the light, soil and drainage first, then draw a planting plan you can build in stages, with or without us.
brand.note: Booking surveys for spring planting now

items.title: Garden survey
items.text: A half-day visit to measure light, soil and drainage, followed by a written summary within a week.

items.title: Planting plan
items.text: A scaled plan with a plant list, sourcing notes and a first-year care calendar.

items.title: Build oversight
items.text: We brief the landscaper you choose and check the work at each stage, so the plan survives the build.

faqs.q: Do you build the gardens yourselves?
faqs.a: No. We design and oversee. We can recommend landscapers we have worked with, or brief one you already trust.
Up to about an hour from the studio. Further visits are quoted separately before anything is booked.
A fixed fee, agreed before the visit. If you go on to commission a planting plan, the survey fee is taken off it.
